tools.name: get_setup_status
tools.description: Returns the current onboarding step, completed items, blockers, the next tool name, owner-facing instruction text, the exact link to open, and the /connect fallback URL.

tools.name: start_account
tools.description: Creates or attaches an account for this setup session. Accepts the owner's email. Returns whether a sign-in email was sent and the /connect fallback URL.

tools.name: start_tesla_oauth
tools.description: Starts Tesla sign-in and returns the hosted OAuth start URL (which redirects to Tesla's documented authorize endpoint) plus owner-facing instruction text. Later get_setup_status calls report denied, expired, or missing-scope failures.

tools.name: verify_vehicle
tools.description: Reports whether the connected car is reachable from cached state and fleet_status (asleep, offline, or unsupported). Does not count as a wake.

tools.name: subscribe
tools.description: Returns a single hosted Stripe Checkout URL or one-tap pay page for the owner to open. Yearly starts a 7-day trial (card required). Monthly charges on the first successful checkout. This tool does not collect or charge a card in the chat.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Lists Standard and Plus monthly and yearly prices, allowances, trial length, and checkout URLs. Yearly includes a 7-day trial. Payment happens on the hosted Stripe page the owner opens.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Creates a hosted Stripe Checkout session for a plan. Interval defaults to year (7-day trial). Returns the URL for the owner to open.

tools.name: get_subscription_status
tools.description: Returns trial/active/none billing state, remaining usage, and whether vehicle tools are gated.

tools.name: cancel_subscription
tools.description: Cancels the owner's subscription at the end of the current period. Access stays until then.

tools.name: get_customer_portal
tools.description: Returns a Stripe Customer Portal URL where the owner can cancel, update the card, or download invoices.

tools.name: list_vehicles
tools.description: Lists vehicles linked to this account after Tesla OAuth and an active trial or subscription. A setup_incomplete error means onboarding is not finished; get_setup_status reports the remaining step.

tools.name: get_vehicle_state
tools.description: Returns vehicle state (charge, climate, lock, location) from a short cache, or a metered vehicle_data read on miss. Does not wake the car.

tools.name: get_battery_and_range
tools.description: Returns battery percent, rated range, charge limit, and charging state. Uses the short cache; a miss is a metered vehicle_data read. Does not wake the car.

tools.name: nearest_superchargers
tools.description: Returns nearby Superchargers from the last cached location. Does not wake the car.

tools.name: get_virtual_key_status
tools.description: Reports whether the virtual key is paired. If not, returns the official tesla.com/_ak pairing link and owner-facing pairing steps. Approving Third-Party Apps is not the same as pairing the key.

tools.name: lock_vehicle
tools.description: Locks the vehicle.

tools.name: unlock_vehicle
tools.description: Unlocks the vehicle. Requires confirm=true unless the owner disabled confirmations. Blocked in read-only mode.

tools.name: actuate_trunk
tools.description: Opens or closes the rear trunk or front trunk (frunk). Opening requires confirm=true when confirmations are on.

tools.name: set_climate
tools.description: Starts or stops cabin climate / preconditioning.

tools.name: set_seat_heater
tools.description: Sets a seat heater level (0-3). Climate on usually works better.

tools.name: set_charge
tools.description: Starts or stops charging, or sets the charge limit percent.

tools.name: honk_horn
tools.description: Honks the horn. The vehicle must be in park.

tools.name: flash_lights
tools.description: Flashes the headlights. The vehicle must be in park.

tools.name: remote_start
tools.description: Remote-starts the vehicle. Requires confirm=true when confirmations are on. Blocked in read-only mode.

tools.name: wake_vehicle
tools.description: Wakes the vehicle. Cached reads do not need a wake. Wakes count against the monthly allowance.

tools.name: get_vehicle_summary
tools.description: Returns a vehicle snapshot: online/asleep, battery, range, lock, climate, sentry, and last location. Uses a short cache; a miss is a metered vehicle_data read. Does not wake the car.

tools.name: get_charging_status
tools.description: Returns charging status: percent, limit, plugged in, power, and minutes to full. Uses a short cache; a miss is a metered vehicle_data read. Does not wake the car.

tools.name: get_charging_history
tools.description: Returns recent charging sessions (home, Supercharger, destination) with kWh and cost when Tesla reports it. Does not wake the car.

tools.name: get_energy_usage
tools.description: Returns Powerwall / solar live status and calendar history when the owner has an energy site. Does not wake the car.

tools.name: get_location
tools.description: Returns latitude/longitude plus a human place name when one can be resolved. Uses a short cache; a miss is a metered vehicle_data read. Does not wake the car.

tools.name: share_destination
tools.description: Sends a destination to the car from address text and/or lat/lon. Returns the command confirmation and cached vehicle state.

tools.name: set_charge_limit
tools.description: Sets the charge limit percent (50–100). Out-of-range values return invalid_arguments.

tools.name: set_scheduled_departure
tools.description: Enables or disables scheduled departure (minutes past midnight). Optionally keeps preconditioning on.

tools.name: set_sentry_mode
tools.description: Turns Sentry Mode on or off.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_setup_status, subscribe, get_pricing, create_checkout, get_customer_portal · Public sink: start_account, share_destination.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_setup_status, subscribe, get_pricing, create_checkout, get_customer_portal · Public sink: start_account, share_destination

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
